think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether the knob defines any sentinel/special numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a different mode (disable/auto/unlimited) rather than representing an ordered magnitude. 3) If such sentinel values exist and change semantics qualitatively, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s). Otherwise, classify as not special.
